issues.on_page: Local Receipts -- Cost-Share Loan for SWIIF Grant $22,582.47
issues.issue: Label says loan. If this is loan proceeds, the rules put it in business_type.debt_proceeds, not receipts. It is printed inside line 16 Total Resources Available, and decision_needed already raises the question, so it is left as a warning.

Broad form line with no breakdown on the page, so 'other' with review is defensible. For an irrigation district this is probably irrigation assessments or water charges. It is 34% of receipts, so the >10% 'other' review applies.

Operating expenses with no function. The extractor rules list water and drainage districts under 'natural resources/conservation', which may fit an irrigation district better than 'utilities'. Judgment call; review already set.
The page doesn't say whether this is principal or interest. Given the SWIIF cost-share loan, it may be mostly loan principal. Assumption; review already set.

issues.on_page: Nine Mile Irrigation District, 2025 Audit Waiver Request, Total of All Funds
issues.issue: The extractor assumed the irrigation district is entirely business-type. The form gives no fund types. Defensible, but irrigation districts could also be read as governmental or natural resources/conservation entities.
Fiscal year end was assumed (the notes say so). Irrigation districts may use a calendar year.
